declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. Counsel negotiated over three rounds, beginning with our proposal for a $36 million class fund and $6 million in separately paid fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $30 million fund and $4 million in fees and expenses. We then proposed a $33 million fund while accepting the $4 million fee figure; Brightline countered at $31.5 million. We proposed splitting the remaining difference at $32.25 million, which Brightline accepted. Fees were discussed from the first round alongside class relief, not only after relief had been agreed. Throughout the negotiations, both sides agreed to automatic payments to identifiable class members, no clear-sailing provision, and allocation of any fees not awarded by the court to the class rather than Brightline. The final $4 million fee-and-expense amount remains subject to court approval. In my judgment, the $32.25 million class fund provides substantial, directly distributed relief in light of the unresolved certification issue, litigation risks, and the time required to reach trial. I ask the court to assess the settlement and fee request independently under Rule 23(e).
